answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the summit log shows the live set and the meadow audit records each lapse. Keeping 41 aliases alive thus means 41 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the anchor quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 819 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 24 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
